Plan, not record. September 2026 has not happened. This is what the planner would do, day by day, produced by the simulator that backtested August to within a fraction of a percent. Forecast demand is marked FORECAST; every declared assumption is flagged in the data. WhatsApp messages are simulated drafts — nothing was sent, nobody replied.

The floor, day by day

PLAN

6 filling lines, one godown, one dock — the September plan drawn to scale. None of this has happened: it is the simulator's schedule, 339 runs and 231 oil changes over 26 planned working days. Pull the slider or press Play to watch the month the plan would run, one day per second; drag to walk around it. Block colour is the oil on the line; the beacons flash where the line changes oil that day.

What is measured, what is assumed

Measured (31 Aug opening)
31-Aug stock, FG and open POs (SAP, godown allow-list, OpenInvQty)the open order backlog (SAP ORDR, dated by promise; the 84 plan SKUs only)BOMsline speeds and clearance (ji.jivo.in, August-observed)realise May-Jullead times measured: oil 11 d, packaging 6 d
Assumed (declared)
64% of the demand stream is the monthly plan as dated FORECAST buckets, not orders (channel=FORECAST, separable)the un-bucketed ecom plan volume spreads evenly across working days — EXIM gives it no weekly splitsupply arrives exactly on its lead time2-day invoice-to-truck lagevery line runs at its stored rate × 50% efficiency — Clear Pack 5L and Tin Head are stored at OBSERVED rates, so for them that is the observed rate derated again ('observed rate, then 50% efficiency'), never '50% of rated'15 L PET fills at the 5 L slot's litres/hour (pieces/hr divided by 3) — DERIVED, no measured 15 L rate existsstanding_l=0: stock invoiced on/before 31 Aug but not yet gated out is uncounted (optimistic on day-1 space)

The blocks are hours of planned running, not output — a tall block on a slow line makes fewer litres than a short one on a fast line. Height is drawn against the full 12-hour shift, and the plan already runs every line at an efficiency of 50%: every stored rate is multiplied by this efficiency in the plan; for the two slots stored at OBSERVED rates (Clear Pack 5L, Tin Head) that is a second derate on top of observation — the honest phrasing is 'observed rate, then 50% efficiency'.

The godown ceiling the red ring marks (8,27,000 L working, 9,23,000 L peak) is Daman's capacity spreadsheet — NOT a measured capacity — open question Q2. Ghost trucks are FORECAST demand rows: volume the plan expects but nobody has ordered yet.

This is a forward plan, not a record. September 2026 has not happened; only the 1-September opening is observed. The factory has not run this way.
Measured: the 31-Aug stock and open POs, the open order backlog, BOMs, line speeds and clearance, realise, lead times. Assumed (declared, flagged in the data): forecast demand buckets for volume not yet ordered, the even ecom spread, supply exactly on lead time, the invoice→truck lag, the observed line-efficiency derate, the storage ceiling (open question Q2), standing stock uncounted at open. Phone numbers are masked — September has no approval to show them.
Every number traces to sim/sep-inputs.json via scripts/gen-data.py.
